author: Yessi93A
quote: Honestly, it's disappointing that GTA VI still has so many bugs and is supposedly targeting only 30 FPS. In 2026, a game of this scale should deliver much better performance. The visuals may be impressive, but graphics mean nothing if the game can't run smoothly. 30 FPS is simply unacceptable for a next-gen title, especially after all the hype and expectations. Rockstar needs to focus less on flashy trailers and more on optimization.
